title: Principles of Electrical Engineering
syllabus: Electric circuit components, mesh current analysis, node voltage analysis, Thevenin's and superposition theorems, single-phase AC circuits (RL, RC, RLC), power and energy calculations, power factor, basics of electrical safety and earthing. Electromechanical energy conversion and the principle of operation of DC motors, induction motors, BLDC motors and the single-phase transformer; concepts of power electronics and industrial applications of electrical drives.

title: Foundations of Electronics and Communication Systems
syllabus: Semiconductor devices: PN junction diode, Zener diode, BJT, MOSFET and operational amplifier; the electromagnetic spectrum, elements of a communication system, modulation, cellular, satellite and radar systems.

title: Engineering Graphics and CAD
syllabus: Introduction to engineering drawing; BIS standards for lines, lettering and dimensioning; orthographic projection (first and third angle); introduction to projection of solids; isometric and perspective projection; freehand sketching; a residential floor plan as per IS SP7; introduction to CAD.

title: Manufacturing, Energy and Mechanical Automation
syllabus: Metal casting, forming, welding, machining, CNC and additive manufacturing; IC engines and power plants; kinematics of mechanisms.
